field_changes.old: Hi there. We fixed a couple bugs and made some performance improvements, so the app should now be almost as speedy as you. Have fun out there!
field_changes.new: A bolder map for every move. Ranked trails, difficulty grades, and MTB grading come to every hike and ride, plus new POIs: trailheads, viewpoints, water, first aid, and more. Your personal heatmap now has a high-contrast option, so it's easier to see where you've been and where you haven't.
